name: RC-B10-0415/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking for action after two earthquakes hit eastern Afghanistan in August 2025, killing over 2,200 people. It asks the Taliban to lift restrictions that block aid, especially for women, and calls on the European Union and other countries to give more money, rebuild homes and health services, and stop deporting Afghans back to a country in crisis.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of requests, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Afghan earthquake survivors, women and girls, and Afghans facing deportation from Iran and Pakistan.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions and member states, which decide whether to act.
